description: Deterministic artifact verifier CLI (file/xlsx/docx/pdf/pptx/text/archive/rubric) for pre-delivery artifact checks and agentic judges. 58 subcommands callable as `verifier {family} {subcmd} [args]`. Use before delivering or uploading a file, or whenever you need to check file format, sheet/section presence, cell values, formulas, keywords, character counts, page counts, placeholders, signatures or zip contents, instead of guessing from an LLM reading. Every call prints one JSON object with a quotable `evidence` field.
